intentAlignment.reason: This Work Item is limited to separating immutable artifact source identity from workflow orchestration identity, preserving the dispatch-only release route and its pre-dispatch fail-closed checks. Product behavior, historical receipts, tag rewriting, full-workspace validation, and unrelated cleanup remain out of scope.

scenarioCoverage.expected: An immutable release tag source commit may differ from the current dispatch workflow commit; both identities remain explicit and bound.
scenarioCoverage.reason: The local policy gate passed under Runtime verification and the workflow records the two identities separately. Hosted review remains a later delivery gate.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect release preflight and policy tests, then verify the reviewed hosted workflow accepts the differing identities.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A missing, lightweight, moved, or locally forged tag is rejected before compilation, while a local tag matching the remote peeled tag is accepted.
scenarioCoverage.reason: The pre-dispatch guard and policy gate passed without spawning a product build.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the static policy gates and inspect the local-versus-remote peeled tag preflight boundary.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The repair never retags v0.2.92 or rewrites an existing Release and does not alter historical evidence.
scenarioCoverage.reason: The repair is source-only and the immutable tag was verified independently before delivery.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare the branch diff and verify tag and Release state before and after the reviewed merge and dispatch.
